rationale: This record is a public procurement contract/tender notice for civil engineering pipeline-design documentation and construction supervision of municipal water supply pipe works in Murowana Goslina, Poland. It contains no empirical research or systematic review (E05) and focuses solely on technical pipeline engineering design and contract execution scope (also failing Criteria 2 and 4).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both the narrow rule-type Criterion 2 reading and the literal plain Criterion 2 reading because the record is a public procurement tender notice for pipeline engineering design services with no empirical study, no research design, and no analysis of legal, administrative, or institutional determinants of household water access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Development of design documentation (construction design and execution), together with a description of the order for the execution of work
